answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops hollow fake identities. A new agent locks a 60-unit deposit and lists its referrer, then a random beacon picks 5 peers to check its work over 20 epochs. To forge 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units in locked deposits plus a visible star-shaped referral cluster that auditors flag and slash together with the referrer. An honest agent locks once, passes one check, and earns undiluted rewards.
